thread:
anya: quick note — ran into a weird HF->Redwood gen-config mapping when onboarding a chat model this morning. sentinel role tokens are leaking into the tokenizer special tokens and the chat prefix ends up double-counted.

sam: can you paste the HF generation_config.json excerpt?

anya: sure — minimal snippet:
```json
{"temperature": "0.7", "top_p": 0.9, "top_k": 50, "repetition_penalty": "1.2", "special_tokens_map": {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|system|>", "<|user|>"]}}
```

sam: aha — two immediate things: 1) strings for numeric fields ("0.7"/"1.2") come through from certain HF exports, our import path currently does not coerce and treats them as missing -> falls back to Redwood defaults. 2) the chat role tokens (<|system|>) are listed in additional_special_tokens so tokenizer.prepend_bos gets confused.

julian: long-term: we should canonicalize generation_config fields on import: coerce numeric strings -> numbers, clamp temperature [0,2], top_p [0,1], and treat top_k null/-1 as "disabled".

sierra: also saw an odd one with rep penalty during int8 quant tests — rep_penalty=1.2 in config but sampling traces show no effect (repeats were unchanged). suspect kernel path for quantized ops uses a different logit handling.

anya: exact reproduction steps I used: import HF repo, run `rw import-model --from hf repo`, then quick smoke using `rw gen --model X --prompt "<|system|>..." --debug-sampling`. Logs show rep_penalty applied earlier but final softmax uses cached logits path (int8) that doesn't reweight.

sam: can you paste debug snippet? small excerpt is fine.

anya: paste:
```
[DEBUG] genparams resolved: {temperature:0.7, top_p:0.9, top_k:50, repetition_penalty:1.2}
[TRACE] tokenized prompt len: 18 (includes <|system|> as special token)
[TRACE] pre-softmax logits adjusted for rep penalty on CPU path
[TRACE] final sample chosen by quantized_kernel_sample() no rep-penalty applied
```

julian: OK this lines up with a missing hook in quantized sampling kernel. Two remedies: 1) ensure rep-penalty is applied as an additive bias to logits in the quantized path before sampling, or 2) have fallback to float kernel when rep_penalty != 1.0 (slower but correct).

sierra: fallback to float if rep_penalty != 1.0 seems safest short-term. we can add a perf test to compare throughput penalty.

sam: unrelated but important — special_tokens_map collision: when both bos_token and role tokens are present, our chat template builder was inserting both an explicit role token and also calling tokenizer.build_prefix which adds bos. results in duplicated tokens at start. leads to off-by-one in KV cache indexing.

anya: repro: model expects prompt: `<|system|> You are a helpful assistant.` but we get `<s> <|system|> You are a helpful assistant.` and the runtime assumes KV cache[0] is BOS while model treats <|system|> as BOS -> cache mismatch.

julian: fix plan: on import, if additional_special_tokens includes role-like tokens (<|system|>, <|user|>, <|assistant|>) then mark them as "role_tokens" and set tokenizer.prepend_bos=false for chat templates. Add a validation check that token ids for role tokens != bos_id.

sierra: also add unit tests covering: (a) numeric-string fields in generation_config.json, (b) top_k:-1 vs null, (c) rep_penalty!=1 forcing float fallback, (d) role token present -> no duplicate bos.

anya: I'm going to open a ticket with repro and attach mini-model + steps. will include perf delta for float fallback.

bench-bot: created ticket INF-3472: "genconfig import coercion + role-token dup + quantized rep-penalty omission" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3472 :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-preview for fix branch available at https://ci.redwood.dev/preview/inf-3472 (smoketest included)

sam: nice. follow-ups: 1) add a migration path for existing onboarded models (small script to reimport or patch metadata), 2) vendor tests to avoid regressions, 3) improve docs section on HF->Redwood mappings (explicit examples for chat models).

julian: extra gotcha — some HF repos use special token aliasing like "pad_token": "<|pad|>" but also map "<|pad|>" in additional_special_tokens. prefer canonical single mapping; we'll canonicalize to tokenizer.pad_token_id and remove duplicates at import.

sierra: agreed. I'll sketch the import validation checklist and send as a short RFC in eng-ml.

anya: thanks team — I'll drop the minimal repro and link to INF-3472 in the RFC.

sam: :eyes: good call. small PR to coerce numeric strings is low-risk, I'll draft it after lunch.

anya: tagged for visibility: @julian @sierra @sam — will ping when ticket has logs attached.

infra-bot: note: test infra will run quantized sampling smoke on next preview.
